categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Ampron Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer specializing in thermistors (PTC/NTC), temperature sensors, pressure sensors, oxygen sensors, and nitrogen oxide sensors. The company operates through multiple business segments including thermistor and temperature sensor products, pressure sensor products (ceramic capacitive, MEMS, and glass-sealed types), oxygen and nitrogen oxide sensors, and force sensors. The company also provides testing services and rental income from its facilities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses a complete vertical industry chain from ceramic material research and development to thermistor and sensor manufacturing. Core technologies include ceramic material formulation, ceramic substrate preparation, forming, sintering, printing, packaging, MEMS pressure sensor chip design, and IC design. The company utilizes advanced manufacturing techniques including ceramic processing, MEMS (Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems) technology, and integrated circuit design to produce high-performance sensors with superior accuracy and reliability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major customers across multiple industries including automotive manufacturers (BYD, SAIC, Stellantis, Tesla, Li Auto, Nio, XPeng, Chery, Geely, Chang'an, FAW, GAC Aion), automotive Tier-1 suppliers (Valeo, Magna, Marelli, Gentherm, Lear, Tuopu Group, Sanhua Intelligent Controls, Wanliyang, Yinglun), home appliance brands (Midea, Gree, Haier, Hisense, TCL, Samsung, Electrolux, Panasonic), and beverage companies (Keurig Dr Pepper, Nestlé Nespresso). The company also serves photovoltaic, energy storage, and industrial automation sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major manufacturing bases in Shenzhen, Chenzhou (Hunan), and Dongguan. The company has established international presence through subsidiaries including Ampron Technology Europe B.V. in Belgium and Shanghai Ampron Technology Co., Ltd. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and international markets, with significant export business to North America, Europe, and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures and supplies core sensor components and finished sensor products to automotive OEMs, Tier-1 automotive suppliers, home appliance manufacturers, and industrial equipment producers. The company controls the complete vertical production chain from raw material processing through final product assembly and testing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technology innovation as its core driver, with strategic focus on developing advanced ceramic material technology, MEMS technology platforms, and integrated circuit design capabilities. Key R&D initiatives include developing next-generation pressure sensors for electric vehicles, temperature-pressure integrated sensors, force sensors for robotics, MEMS pressure sensors for various automotive applications, and smart sensor products. The company is also establishing international R&D centers in Europe and Shanghai to attract global talent and accelerate technology development.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured sensor products to automotive OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, and home appliance manufacturers. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of the products, typically upon delivery and confirmation of quantity and amount. The company also generates revenue from testing services provided to customers and rental income from facility leasing. The company operates on a make-to-order production model based on customer orders.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic manufacturer of car-grade pressure sensors and has achieved significant import substitution in the Chinese market. The company competes with both international sensor manufacturers and domestic competitors. The company has been recognized as a national-level specialized and innovative 'little giant' enterprise by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and ranks among China's top ten sensor companies according to Sedi Consultant. The company differentiates itself through advanced technology, comprehensive product portfolio, and strong automotive customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved 2024 revenue of 940.16 million yuan, representing 25.93% growth compared to 746.57 million yuan in 2023. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was 82.64 million yuan in 2024, compared to 79.89 million yuan in 2023, representing 3.44% growth. Total assets were 1.97 billion yuan at year-end 2024. The company demonstrates solid growth trajectory with expanding revenue base and improving profitability, supported by strong demand in automotive and home appliance sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through comprehensive vertical integration of the supply chain from material development to final product assembly, enabling superior product performance and reliability. Key competitive advantages include advanced ceramic material formulations, proprietary MEMS technology, comprehensive product portfolio covering low, medium, and high-pressure ranges, industry-leading quality control systems with CNAS-certified laboratories, and strong technical expertise in automotive applications. The company emphasizes zero-defect quality assurance and provides customized solutions for complex automotive and industrial applications, positioning itself as a trusted supplier for demanding customers.
